```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## ==========================================================
## TFCE fully crossed subject-item analysis in R
##
## Input:
##   ../data/08_designTable.csv
##   ../data/08_EEGdata_long.csv
##
## Model used for marginalization:
##   Amplitude ~ ConditionCode +
##     (1 | Subject) +
##     (1 | Item)
##
## Marginalization:
##   Subject- and item-specific random effects are removed.
##
## Local model after marginalization:
##   MarginalAmplitude ~ ConditionCode
##
## Test:
##   Treatment - Control fixed effect
##
## Condition coding:
##   Control   = -1
##   Treatment =  1
##
## Permutation:
##   Condition labels are shuffled unrestricted after marginalization
##
## EEG amplitudes are never permuted.
## Only condition labels are permuted.
## ==========================================================

rm(list = ls())

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(future)
library(progressr)
library(future.apply)
source("../R/TFCE_transform.R")
source("../R/TFCE_adjusted_p.R")

cat("\nStarting fully crossed subject-item TFCE analysis...\n")

## ==========================================================
## -1. Load EEG long-format data
## ==========================================================

designTable <- read.csv("../Data/09_designTable.csv")
EEGlong <- read.csv("../Data/09_EEGdata_long.csv")

print(names(designTable))
print(names(EEGlong))

## ==========================================================
## 0. Prepare data
## ==========================================================

channels <- unique(EEGlong$Channel)
times <- sort(unique(EEGlong$Time))
subject <- unique(EEGlong$SubjID)
target <- unique(EEGlong$Target)

nChan <- length(channels)
nTime <- length(times)
nSubj <- length(subject)
nTarget <- length(target)

cat("Number of observations in EEGlong:", nrow(EEGlong), "\n")
cat("Number of channels:", nChan, "\n")
cat("Number of time points:", nTime, "\n")
cat("Number of subjects:", nSubj, "\n")
cat("Number of time targets:", nTarget, "\n")

## ==========================================================
## Basic checks
## ==========================================================

subject_item_units <- designTable %>% distinct(SubjID, Target)

N_units = rep(NA, length(subject_item_units))
for (u in seq_len(nrow(subject_item_units))) {
  current_subject <- subject_item_units$SubjID[u]
  current_item <- subject_item_units$Target[u]
  
  tmp <- designTable %>%
    filter(SubjID == current_subject, Target == current_item)
  
  N_units[u] <- nrow(tmp)
}

cat("Basic design checks completed.\n")


# Calculate the intended admissible transformation
N_addtrans = prod(factorial(N_units))
  
cat("Number of intended admissble transformation:", N_addtrans, "\n")


# Calculate the actual addmissible transformation
## ==========================================================
## Basic checks and permutation counts
## ==========================================================

# Assumes designTable has one row per planned trial.
subject_item_units <- designTable %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  count(SubjID, Target, name = "n_intended")

# One row per retained trial is expected at each channel?Ctime point.
n_map_points <- nChan * nTime

eeg_counts <- EEGlong %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  count(SubjID, Target, Channel, Time, name = "n_at_point") %>%
  group_by(SubjID, Target) %>%
  summarise(
    n_points = n(),
    min_at_point = min(n_at_point),
    max_at_point = max(n_at_point),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

unit_counts <- full_join(
  subject_item_units, eeg_counts,
  by = c("SubjID", "Target")
) %>%
  mutate(
    n_points = coalesce(n_points, 0L),
    n_retained = case_when(
      n_points == 0L ~ 0L,
      n_points == n_map_points & min_at_point == max_at_point ~ min_at_point,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

log10_intended <- sum(lfactorial(subject_item_units$n_intended)) / log(10)
cat(sprintf("log10 intended permutation count: %.3f\n", log10_intended))

check_units <- unit_counts %>%
  filter(is.na(n_intended) | is.na(n_retained) | n_retained > n_intended)

if (nrow(check_units) > 0L) {
  print(check_units)
  cat("Review these pairs before calculating a whole-map permutation count.\n")
} else {
  log10_retained <- sum(lfactorial(unit_counts$n_retained)) / log(10)
  cat(sprintf("log10 estimated retained permutation count: %.3f\n",
              log10_retained))
}

EEGlong <- EEGlong %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    SubjID = factor(SubjID),
    Target = factor(Target),
    JSD = C(factor(JSD), contr.sum),
    ClassifierCongruency = C(factor(ClassifierCongruency), contr.sum),
    NumbersofStorks = as.numeric(scale(NumbersofStorks)),
    Frequency = log(Frequency),
    LengthofDistrctor = as.numeric(scale(LengthofDistrctor))
  )


designTable <- designTable %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    SubjID = factor(SubjID),
    Target = factor(Target),
    JSD = C(factor(JSD), contr.sum),
    ClassifierCongruency = C(factor(ClassifierCongruency), contr.sum),
    NumbersofStorks = as.numeric(scale(NumbersofStorks)),
    Frequency = log(Frequency),
    LengthofDistrctor = as.numeric(scale(LengthofDistrctor))
  )
## ==========================================================
## Step 0: Remove subject and item random effects
##
## For each channel-time point, fit:
##
##   Amplitude ~ ConditionCode +
##     (1 | Subject) +
##     (1 | Item)
##
## The marginalized response is:
##
##   fixed-effect fitted values + conditional residuals
##
## This removes the estimated subject- and item-specific
## random intercepts while preserving the condition effect
## and unexplained residual variation.
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 0: Removing subject and item random effects...\n")

marginal_dat <- EEGlong %>%
  group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
  group_modify( ~ {
    fit <- lmer(Amplitude ~ NumbersofStorks + Frequency + LengthofDistrctor +
                  ClassifierCongruency + JSD +
                  (1 | SubjID) +
                  (1 | Target), data = .x)
    
    fixed_fitted <- predict(fit, re.form = NA)
    
    conditional_residuals <- residuals(fit)
    
    .x %>%
      mutate(MarginalAmplitude =
               fixed_fitted +
               conditional_residuals)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Marginalization stage completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## -2. Function to compute the local t-map
##
## After marginalization, the local model is:
##
##   MarginalAmplitude ~ ConditionCode
## ==========================================================

compute_tmap <- function(data) {
  res <- data %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    group_modify( ~ {
      fit <- lm(MarginalAmplitude ~ NumbersofStorks + Frequency + LengthofDistrctor +
                  ClassifierCongruency + JSD, data = .x)
      
      cf <- coef(summary(fit))
      
      tibble(t_Cond = cf["JSDL", "t value"])
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  t_values <- res %>%
    mutate(
      Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
      Time = factor(Time, levels = times)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Channel, Time) %>%
    pull(t_Cond)
  
  matrix(
    t_values,
    nrow = nChan,
    ncol = nTime,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(channels, times)
  )
}

## ==========================================================
## Step 1: Observed t-map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 1: Computing observed t-map...\n")

t_Obs <- compute_tmap(marginal_dat)

cat("Observed t-map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 2: Observed TFCE map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 2: Computing observed TFCE map...\n")

TFCE_Obs <- tfce_transform(t_Obs, E = 0.5, H = 2, dh = 0.1)

cat("Observed TFCE map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 3: Permutation distribution
## ==========================================================

set.seed(123)

n_perm <- 999

cat("Step 3: Starting permutation test:", n_perm , "permutations...\n")

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3.1. Set up parallel processing
## ------------------------------------------------------------

n_workers <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)

plan(multisession, workers = n_workers -10)

future::plan(future::sequential)

handlers("txtprogressbar")

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3.2 Parallel permutation test
## ------------------------------------------------------------

with_progress({
  progress_update <- progressor(along = seq_len(n_perm))
  
  TFCE_extrema <- future_sapply(seq_len(n_perm), function(p) {
    perm_info <- designTable %>% group_by(SubjID, Target) %>%
      mutate(JSD = sample(JSD))
    
  perm_marginal_dat <- marginal_dat %>%
    select(-JSD) %>% left_join(
      perm_info %>% select(SubjID, Target, Marker3, JSD),
      by = c('SubjID', 'Target', 'Marker3')
      )
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## 3.1 Compute permutation t-map
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  t_perm <- compute_tmap(perm_marginal_dat)
  
  TFCE_perm <- tfce_transform(t_perm, E = 0.5, H = 2, dh = 0.1)
  
  tfce_window <- TFCE_perm[, 52:168, drop = FALSE]
  perm_extrema <- c(
    perm_max = max(tfce_window, na.rm = TRUE),
    perm_min = min(tfce_window, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  progress_update()
  
  perm_extrema
  }, future.seed = TRUE, future.packages = c("dplyr", "tidyr", "lme4", "lmerTest"))
  })

cat("Permutation testing completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 4: TFCE-corrected significance
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 4: Computing TFCE-corrected significance...\n")

alpha <- 0.05

## Step 4: Compute TFCE-adjusted p-values

TFCE_p_adj <- TFCE_adjusted_p(
  observed_map = TFCE_Obs,
  perm_max = TFCE_extrema["perm_max", ],
  perm_min = TFCE_extrema["perm_min", ]
)

stopifnot(identical(dimnames(TFCE_p_adj), dimnames(TFCE_Obs)))

cat("Number of points with TFCE-adjusted p <= 0.05:",
    sum(TFCE_p_adj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("TFCE-corrected significance completed.\n")


## ==========================================================
## Step 5: Store results
## ==========================================================
Mask <- P_Values <= alpha
cat("Channel-time points with adjusted p <=", alpha, ":", sum(Mask), "\n")

# 7. Save results ---------------------------------------------------------

Results <- list(
  tObs = t_Obs,
  TFCE_Obs = TFCE_Obs,
  P_Values = P_Values,
  Mask = Mask,
  alpha = alpha,
  n_perm = n_perm,
  tfce_settings = tfce_settings,
  permutation_extrema = TFCE_extrema,
  unit_counts = unit_counts,
  mixed_model = deparse1(mixed_model),
  local_model = deparse1(local_model),
  test = "High versus low JSD",
  marginalization = "Estimated subject and target random intercepts removed",
  permutation = "JSD labels shuffled within subject-target pairs"
)

dir.create("../Results", showWarnings = FALSE)
result_file <- "../Results/09_TFCE_fully_crossed_subject_item_results.RData"
save(Results, times, nChan, channels, file = result_file)

cat(paste0(
  "Fully crossed subject-item TFCE analysis ",
  "completed and results saved.\n"
))
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
rm(list = ls())
load("../Results/09_TFCE_fully_crossed_subject_item_results.RData")
source("../R/plot_eeg_map.R")
## ==========================================================
## Step 7: Plot significant effects
## ==========================================================

mT <- Results$tObs
mT[!Results$Mask] <- 0

plot_eeg_map(mT, "TFCE-corrected Group Effect", times, nChan, channels)

## ==========================================================
## Step 7: Plot observed TFCE values
## ==========================================================

plot_eeg_map(Results$TFCE_Obs,
             "Observed TFCE Map: Group Effect Adjusted for Covariate",
             times,
             nChan, channels)
```
